title: Star Wars: Fall of the Empire

source.label: Kineticist Star Wars: Fall of the Empire tournament guide

supportingSources.label: August 2026 full game on exact code 0.97

strategy.summary: Prepare two Hoth locks and leave the third lit, then start Lightspeed Escape. Collect the third lock during Escape to start Battle of Hoth; use its extra balls to raise the Lightspeed Jackpot, then shoot the center ramp for Lightspeed Multiball. Advance J-E-D-I opportunistically during single-ball play.

steps.text: Full-plunge the ball, catch the feed on the left flipper, and backhand the Droids target to light the first Hoth lock. During controlled single-ball play, use either orbit to advance J-E-D-I, but do not delay the prepared stack solely to finish it.
modeNotes: JEDI progress: The orbit spinners advance J-E-D-I only during single-ball play.

steps.text: Shoot the Luke VUK to collect the lit Hoth lock. Hit the Droids target and collect the second lock at Luke, then hit Droids again but leave the third lock lit.
modeNotes: Battle of Hoth qualification: The first start needs three locks. Later starts need more Droids-target hits, and each lock must be collected before the next can light.

steps.text: While the Falcon's blue engines are lit, shoot the center ramp for advances until Lightspeed Escape begins. Do not shoot the center ramp again before Hoth starts.
modeNotes: Lightspeed Escape: Yellow shots build the Lightspeed jackpot. Shooting the center ramp during Escape starts Lightspeed Multiball immediately.

steps.text: During Lightspeed Escape, shoot the Luke VUK to collect the third lock and start Battle of Hoth Multiball.
During Hoth, shoot the yellow shots to raise the Lightspeed Jackpot, then shoot the center ramp to start Lightspeed Multiball.
For Lightspeed, shoot the three blue Jackpots, then loop the center ramp while the Super Jackpot is lit. Each later cycle adds one Jackpot to the requirement.
modeNotes: Lightspeed Multiball: Lit shots score jackpots. The center ramp then scores a repeatable Super Jackpot for about 15 seconds. When the timer ends, the jackpot phase starts again.

steps.text: For Hoth, score one jackpot, then hit the Droids target for the first AT-AT letter. Repeat with two, three, and four jackpots before the next letters. After A-T-A-T, shoot the Luke VUK for the Super Jackpot.
modeNotes: Battle of Hoth Multiball: Each Droids-target letter jackpot scores the total of the jackpots in that wave. The Luke Super Jackpot scores 5,000,000 plus all letter jackpots. The cycle then resets at a higher base value.

steps.text: Make 10 Sarlacc Pit spins, then press the lit action button to add a ball to the stack.
modeNotes: Add-a-ball: The button spends one stored add-a-ball for the complete multiball stack. Later add-a-balls need 20, 30, then 40 spins. Unused progress stays at the prior requirement.

steps.text: Play a Rebel Mission for four different characters. When no other mode is running, shoot the lit left scoop to start Not a Jedi Yet.
Play all three Jabba events. Then repeat the Salacious Crumb drop-target hits and shoot the Sarlacc Pit to start Sarlacc Escape as the fourth event.
Play the first three Falcon features. For the fourth, use the right ramp to light the Falcon engines, then shoot the center ramp for advances until Never Tell Me The Odds starts.
Complete a Vader mode, then collect 10 roving purple Dark Side shots. Shoot the lit purple left scoop to start Dark Side Multiball.

editionDifferences.pro: Shoot the right ramp to qualify the center ramp for progress.
editionDifferences.premium: Hit the target under the center ramp. This raises the ramp and enables progress.

editionDifferences.pro: Spell all of JEDI. After the ball rolls through a lit outlane, press the action button before the drain.
editionDifferences.premium: Two or three JEDI letters enable one magnet pulse per letter. Full JEDI lets the magnet grab and throw the ball. Unused pulses stay available.
After two Mystery awards, Mystery can start this multiball when no other multiball runs. Hit the lowered center ramp 10 times to light Extra Ball.

editionDifferences.pro: Each right-ramp shot awards one TIE Fighter.
editionDifferences.premium: Each right-ramp shot awards one. A center-ramp to right-ramp combo awards two.

techniques.name: Droids-target backhand
techniques.instruction: Full-plunge, live-catch on the left flipper, then backhand the Droids target.

techniques.name: Sarlacc backhand
techniques.instruction: Backhand Salacious Crumb and the Sarlacc Pit from the right flipper, then nudge the Sarlacc exit toward the left flipper.

techniques.name: Orbit loop pass
techniques.instruction: Loop-pass or catch each orbit feed before setting up the next major shot.

cautions.issue: The Sarlacc exit can return without control.
cautions.response: Nudge the exit toward the left flipper and prepare to catch it.

strategy.overview: Star Wars: Fall of the Empire lets Lightspeed Escape run into Hoth, then Lightspeed Multiball. Hit Droids and Luke VUK for two locks, then Droids again. Shoot the center ramp to light the Falcon's blue engines; repeat until Escape starts. Collect the third lock at Luke for Hoth; shoot yellow shots to raise the Lightspeed Jackpot, then the center ramp for Lightspeed Multiball.
strategy.simpleOverview: Star Wars: Fall of the Empire uses F-O-R-C-E for Rebel Missions, Droids and Luke for Hoth locks, and Ion Cannons for shot multipliers. Complete F-O-R-C-E, then shoot a lit character shot to start its yellow Mission. Hit Droids to light each lock and Luke VUK to collect it; the third starts Hoth. After Ion Cannon bumper hits, shoot the shot you want multiplied next.
